name: Raise (2E): any car (raw messages)
description: Raise (RZC) box and most other makers (Simple, Bagoo, Binary, Oudi, Luzheng…): 2E CMD LEN data CS, CS = (CMD + LEN + data) XOR FF, 38400 bit/s; the head unit acknowledges each message with the byte FF and says hello (81 01) at the start, as the Raise profiles do. Any car: no decoding, raw messages. Also the description of this box type ("box": "raise" or one of its makers).
